title: Pre-discovery creative brief for the representative sample (t_sample / f_sample under c_sample)
status_statement: Provider-neutral translation of the saved sample contract for a FUTURE PixelLab request. No PixelLab operation or inputSchema has been discovered in this session (pixl_readiness: official PixelLab tools not observed; pixl_capabilities is a dated catalog with live_discovery=false). This brief is therefore not executable, is not provider arguments, and must not be dispatched. pixl_request_review (pixl-kit/runtime/pixl/request_review.py lines 130-134) requires request.kind == 'provider_arguments' and rejects this file; the packet becomes reviewable by that tool only after translation into exact arguments against the live declaration.

deliverable.what: one static sprite image: the scout as the representative side-view figure, single idle pose, no role device
deliverable.alpha: binary (every pixel alpha 0 or 255); transparent exterior
deliverable.file: PNG carrying alpha (RGBA, or indexed with a fully transparent index); exactly one frame
deliverable.sampling: nearest; delivered bytes are the logical grid and are never resampled
deliverable.subject_scope: scout silhouette only; the scout/medic role device is out of scope (i_role_diff unresolved)

intent.composed_text_exact_c_sample_li: [1 lighting; observed from reference.png and reference-b.png (i_lighting, s_refobs)] Flat colour: no directional light, no shading ramps. [2 design language; PIXL proposal awaiting owner agreement (i_design_language)] Carry the references' flat colour, absent anti-aliasing, binary alpha and blocky low-detail construction into a genuinely side-view figure; the references' front-facing symmetric shape is a style swatch, not the character design. [3 outline; controlled-evaluation sample confirmation (i_outline, sources/controlled-evaluation-answers.md): sample only, not an owner preference, not family or production policy] Outlined as reference.png: a flat #25354A contour at the weight shown there (2 logical px) fully enclosing the figure and also carrying the shoulder bar, base bar and solid top stalks, adapted to the side view; the no-outline treatment of reference-b.png stays open for the family. [4 identity landmarks for the readability criterion; PIXL construction proposal under component 2, not an owner requirement] (a) two top stalks separated by a notch, solid in the contour colour; (b) cream eye placement adapted to profile so the figure has an unambiguous facing direction; (c) the navy shoulder bar; (d) the navy base bar; (e) the enclosing navy contour separating the figure from the background. The single idle pose faces right, a scoped specialist choice for the sample that the engine can mirror.

provider_wording_rules: Reduce the components to provider prose without the authority labels, but keep every negative constraint explicit: no anti-aliasing, no gradients or shading ramps, no dithering, no drop shadow, transparent background, outline only in #25354A.
Do not write 'confirmed', 'the owner wants' or 'final' anywhere in the prompt; the authority of each component is recorded here and in the criteria, not asserted to the provider.
A filename written in the prompt is not an uploaded reference; reference.png must travel as an actual image input (see references).

Keep the three working colours in the prompt as hex values only if the operation's documentation says prompt colours are honoured; otherwise rely on the style image and the local palette check afterwards.
Do not ask for extra variants, directions, animations or a role accent.

output_cardinality.rule: If the operation returns several candidates per call, retain all returned bytes with their hashes; import as X candidates only those actually reviewed; nominate at most one for f_sample. Do not order additional variants merely because a mode returns them. A returned larger sheet (for example a character template) is not the deliverable; any crop or resize is a derived candidate needing its own review.

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Does the operation accept a fixed output size, and is 32 x 32 an allowed value? Which field(s) (width/height, size enum, template) and what min/max?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.why: c_sample.px is pinned to [32,32]; generating at another size and resizing is not equivalent pixel art
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: report the mismatch and propose the nearest supported native size as a staged path for the caller to adopt; do not change c_sample silently

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Which input field carries style reference images, how many are accepted, and by what transport (get_upload_url handle, URL, base64, owned asset ID)? Is the style anchor distinct from an init/content image?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.why: reference.png is the style anchor; a filename in prose transmits nothing
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: a text-only route is an approximation and must be labelled so in the reviewed request

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Does the operation produce a transparent background, and does the declaration or documentation say whether alpha is binary or may contain partial values?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: any thresholding/cutout is a post-process producing a derived candidate that must be reviewed anew

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: How many images does one call return (single image vs candidate grid/multiple), and can the count be set to 1?

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: retain all, nominate one, record the actual count in the job evidence

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Is the fitting operation a single-image tool (create_image_*) or a character tool (create_character)? Does the character route impose direction sets, template sizes or animation packaging beyond one static 32 x 32 side-view frame?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.why: the sample is one static sprite; later family needs do not justify a larger deliverable now
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: prefer the single-image route for the sample and revisit character resources when i_animation/i_role_diff are answered

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Where does the intent text go (field name, length limit) and are there parameter-level controls for outline, shading, detail or view that can carry components 1-3 instead of prose?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.why: parameters are more reliable than prose for negative constraints
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: carry them in prose and rely on the saved criteria

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Is there a forced-palette or colour-limit parameter?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: palette remains a post-check; an off-palette result is a failed or edited candidate, not a reason to loosen the sample rule

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: Which poll/retrieve tool returns the bytes and job state for the chosen operation, and what retry interval does it declare?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.why: job-observe needs the actual returned identifier and retrieval route

schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.question: What does the account's current balance/quote say for one call of the chosen operation?
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.why: paid operation; the user's limits must be respected
schema_questions_for_the_live_declaratio.if_no: do not dispatch without authorization covering the actual cost
